# Support

AUTOMA GP is maintained by one person in their free time. Italian and
English are both fine.

- **Questions and ideas**: open a thread in
  [Discussions](https://github.com/gpicchiarelli/AutomaGP/discussions).
- **Bugs and feature requests**: open an
  [issue](https://github.com/gpicchiarelli/AutomaGP/issues/new/choose)
  using the matching template. Include the SBCL version, the output of
  `(ql:quickload :automa-gp)`, and the smallest REPL transcript that
  shows the problem.
- **Security reports**: follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Do not open
  a public issue.

Before asking, check the [FAQ](../docs/faq.md) and
[architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md); most questions about
simulate versus run, adapters, and persistence are answered there.
